北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力 4 级体感较凉，外出添衣，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has a noticeable breeze and feels cool. Dress warmly when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雨，湿度大，记得带伞，小心路滑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella, and watch your step!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雨，空气湿润，记得带伞，出门小心慢行。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is rainy and humid. Remember your umbrella and take care when out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云舒适，气温 26℃，注意防晒补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and pleasant at 26℃. Remember sun protection and hydration.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 25℃，湿度较高，穿着透气更舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy at 25℃ with high humidity. Wear breathable clothing.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，微凉湿润，记得带伞，路面湿滑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain, cool and humid. Bring an umbrella, roads may be slick.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾，能见度低，开车的朋友注意安全！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has heavy fog, low visibility. Drivers, please stay safe!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 21℃，早晚添衣，谨防着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy at 21℃. Add layers in morning/evening to avoid catching cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云 17℃，湿度较高，感觉舒适但注意防潮。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy at 17℃ with high humidity. Feels comfortable, but mind the dampness.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，气温 23℃，多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry at 23℃. Drink more water to stay hydrated.
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云 22℃，体感舒适，户外活动很不错哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and comfortable at 22℃. Great for outdoor activities!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨下雪啦！体感 -5℃，防寒保暖要做好！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is snowing! Feels like -5℃. Make sure to keep warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有雨，体感 -1℃，风力大，注意添衣防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has rain, feels like -1℃ with strong wind. Dress warmly to protect from cold.
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 22℃，体感舒适，早晚温差注意调节。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and comfortable at 22℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雨，湿度大，出门带伞，路面小心湿滑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has rain and high humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for slick roads.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 4℃ 较冷，风大，多穿衣慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has heavy fog, feels cold at 4℃ with strong wind. Dress warmly and drive slowly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，气温 11℃，虽有阳光，也要注意保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny at 11℃. Though sunny, remember to keep warm.
